visual_identity.pattern_strategy: Translucent 'Leopard-Seal' rosettes clustered near the flippers and tail, mapped cleanly along its horizontal profile.
visual_identity.integument: Sleek and oily-looking skin texture optimized for high-speed diving, running uniformly across its horizontal lateral flank.
visual_identity.facial_silhouette: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The very long, thin, needle-point snout is oriented perfectly parallel to the camera plane.

pose: The small pliosaurid is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original dynamic mid-dive pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its needle-point snout, short neck, gracile torso, flippers (flattened toward the camera plane), and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
